name: Starter Humour
description: Template prompts for comedic timing, escalation, and callbacks.

prompts.title: Absurd complaint
prompts.prompt: I want to complain to the council because a pigeon keeps following me and I think it's becoming personal. Help me make this sound serious

prompts.title: Dog poo
prompts.prompt: I’ve been manifesting my neighbour being nicer to me, and today he ignored me when I said hello. So now I’m manifesting his dog doing a shit in his living room.  Am I being petty?

prompts.title: Escalating excuse
prompts.prompt: Give me an increasingly ridiculous set of excuses for why I am late, starting normal and ending completely unhinged.

prompts.title: Petty revenge
prompts.prompt: My neighbour keeps parking slightly over the line. Suggest petty but harmless revenge plans with excellent dramatic flair.

prompts.title: Pigeon paranoia
prompts.prompt: Why is someone getting shit on by a pigeon so funny?
